summary: Master donor compliance for USAID, EU and World Bank-funded projects with practical tools, control templates, and audit-ready reporting exercises.
lede: Donor compliance for funded projects provides a practical system for interpreting award terms, checking cost support, documenting procurement decisions, and preparing audit-ready evidence. It helps finance and programme teams demonstrate allowability, allocability, competition, and reliable reporting across live projects. You will build and apply a compliance matrix, exceptions register, reporting calendar, and control weakness tracker. Through cost checks, file reviews, and structured documentation routines, the course helps you manage tight reporting cycles, digital file trails, manual reconciliations, and donor oversight with greater consistency.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with donor-funded projects and need stronger control over compliance, evidence, and reporting. It fits people who handle grants, finance, procurement, programme delivery, or internal assurance across USAID, EU, and World Bank-funded work.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, a spreadsheet tool such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, and sample donor documents if your organization permits. A basic understanding of grant budgets, procurement approvals, and project reporting will help you complete the exercises more effectively.
